$comment: Every model id the room uses, as <provider>/<model>, where provider is <harness>-<role>. Role prompts carry {{placeholders}} the plugin fills from this file when a seat is created, so a model change needs no prompt edit. Any harness can hold any role: a Codex Supervisor is seats.supervisor.provider = "codex-supervisor/<model>", a Claude-only Peer tier lists claude-peer models. A seat named here is set up with the room. The values below are one author's setup, not a default of the room. modes: the Paseo session mode a seat is created in, per harness; null for a harness that has none (Pi), where passing any mode is refused.

cheap.use: mechanical, fully specified: extraction, renames, formatting, log triage, doc edits, test scaffolds

default.use: implementation, debugging, multi-file changes with invariants, research with judgement
default.never: the review of a candidate a Claude Peer wrote

cross-family.use: the reviewer of a Claude-written candidate, a tie-break, a retry after a Claude Peer failed, one of two lenses

high.use: a hard question or design (spec arch or review), a lens when the question is hard

extra.use: the hardest judgement: deciding a design or an architecture, arguing whether code is correct under concurrency or failure, a third lens, or the other of two lenses on another model family
